verdict.rationale: A phone service with business features could plausibly offer a public API, so the axis applies. The evidence only documents an app, an online dashboard and human-assisted porting, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path. The llms.txt file is marketing content, not an API, so there is no evidence of a documented public API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
